paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Avya: Bava Batra 19a; Menachot 43b; Niddah 58a. In Rav Chisda's time. Ameimar bar Mar Yenuka, son of Rav Chisda, appeared before him. In Rav Yehudah's name: Yevamot 39b.
